Date: 08/06/2026

## Goal

Document how raw agroinfiltration images were allocated to scorers, so that the
expected number of scores collected by each scorer (and each scorer pair) can be
reasoned about in the downstream analyses.

## Strategy

- The estimated total number of cell death areas (CDAs) per raw agro image was taken as `leaf_count * pos_per_leaf`.
- Image order was randomised.
- Images were divided equally (by CDA count) between scorers using a staggered approach, so that some scorers never scored the same image:

| Dataset portion (all equal in size) | Scorer1 | Scorer2 | Scorer3 |
|-------------------------------------|---------|---------|---------|
| A                                   | 1       | 2       | 3       |
| B                                   | 2       | 3       | 4       |
| C                                   | 3       | 4       | 5       |
| D                                   | 4       | 5       | 6       |
| E                                   | 5       | 6       | 7       |
| F                                   | 6       | 7       | 8       |
| G                                   | 7       | 8       | 9       |
| H                                   | 8       | 9       | 1       |
| I                                   | 9       | 1       | 2       |

The allocation itself is produced by `allocations.py` and recorded in
`randomised_info.csv` (per-image scorer assignments) and `image_info.csv`
(per-image CDA counts).

## 1. Total raw images

```{python}
# 1
import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path

repo_root = next(p for p in [Path.cwd(), *Path.cwd().parents] if (p / '.git').exists())
image_info = pd.read_csv(repo_root / "analyses" / "01_generate_raw_data" / "01_allocation_info" / "image_info.csv")
n_raw_images = image_info[["Path", "Image"]].drop_duplicates().shape[0]
n_raw_images
```

## 2. Raw images per set

```{python}
# 2
images_per_set = image_info.drop_duplicates(subset=["Path", "Image"]).groupby("Set").size()
images_per_set
```

## 3. Scorers

```{python}
# 3.1
randomised_info = pd.read_csv(repo_root / "analyses" / "01_generate_raw_data" / "01_allocation_info" / "randomised_info.csv")
scorer_cols = ["scorer1", "scorer2", "scorer3"]

scorers_by_set = randomised_info.groupby("Set")[scorer_cols].apply(lambda df: set(df.to_numpy().ravel()))
set1_scorers, set2_scorers = scorers_by_set[1], scorers_by_set[2]
all_scorers = set1_scorers | set2_scorers
shared_scorers = set1_scorers & set2_scorers

n_scorers_total = len(all_scorers)
n_scorers_total
```

```{python}
# 3.2
n_scorers_per_set = scorers_by_set.apply(len)
n_scorers_per_set
```

```{python}
# 3.3
n_scorers_shared = len(shared_scorers)
n_scorers_shared
```

## 4. Annotations per CDA

```{python}
# 4
assert randomised_info[scorer_cols].notna().all().all(), "expected scorer1/2/3 populated for every image"
annotations_per_cda = len(scorer_cols)
annotations_per_cda
```
